batches.brief: Messages that mention a product problem word (broken, size, missing, part, …) but where the customer does NOT actually want anything done about an order — e.g. a negation ("not broken, just asking"), a hypothetical, praise, or a question before buying.

messages.message: Hi, I bought the TRAIL-RUNNER-42 but they are not broken at all! Just checking if you do normal size exchanges or if I have to send them back with a fault report.
messages.writer_intent: The customer is asking about the exchange policy for non-defective items.

messages.message: Hello, I am thinking about buying the CITY-JACKET. Is the medium size running small? My sister has one and the shoulders feel a bit tight.
messages.writer_intent: The customer is asking for sizing advice before making a purchase.

messages.message: Hi, I ordered the BACKPACK-30L in black (order #TO-30077) and the zipper feels a bit stiff. Is this supposed to be broken out of the box or does it loosen up after first use?
messages.writer_intent: The customer is asking if a stiff zipper is a defect or normal behavior.

messages.message: Guten Tag, ich überlege, die KL-170-FLT Filter für meinen alten Kessel zu bestellen. Müssen diese immer im Set mit dem Grundteil KL-170-BASE bestellt werden, oder kann ich nur das Filterteil haben?
messages.writer_intent: The customer is asking if spare parts can be bought individually.

messages.message: あ、あの、DESK-LAMPの調光がうまくかないんですが、これは故障でしょうか？それとも設定の問題ですか？まだ保証期間内ですが、どうしても交換したくないんです。
messages.writer_intent: The customer is asking for troubleshooting help for a lamp lighting issue.

batches.brief: Pure questions / inquiries: availability of spare parts, sizes, shipping times, policies, product use.

messages.message: hey, i just got my kettle (order TO-50110) and the water tastes a bit metallic. does the limescale filter KL-170-FLT fit this model? also, is the lid sold separately or was it missing from the box?
messages.writer_intent: Check if specific spare parts are available or included for their kettle.

messages.message: Hi, I am looking for a gas valve for my camping stove, but I don't remember the exact order number, maybe it was to-60206? Do you have the CS-VALVE-2 in stock? I need it urgently for a trip next weekend.
messages.writer_intent: Confirm availability and stock for a specific camping stove spare part.

messages.message: 我買的是 Cities 雨衣中號，但覺得袖子太短了。請問有沒有加大一點的款式，或者 M 到 L 之間的尺寸嗎？另外我想知道退貨政策，因為還沒拆吊牌。
messages.writer_intent: Inquire about alternative sizes and return policy for a rain jacket.

messages.message: Hola, acabo de pedir unas merino socks talla M y quería saber si tienen tallas intermedias como S/L por si acaso no me quedan. Además, ¿cuánto tarda la entrega usualmente a España? Vi que son final sale pero better to be safe.
messages.writer_intent: Ask about size range options and estimated shipping time to Spain.

messages.message: Hallo, ich habe vor kurzem eine LED-Tischlampe in Schwarz gekauft (Bestellung TO-50140). Das Licht flackert ein wenig. Kenne ich da ein Ersatzteil wie den DL-LED-5W Modull, das ich selbst einsetzen kann? Oder ist das schwierig?
messages.writer_intent: Ask if a specific LED module spare part is user-replaceable and how to install it.

messages.message: トレイルランナーの42サイズですが、幅が狭いです。幅広のサイズアップはおすすめですか？それとも43サイズで好みが分かれるのでしょうか？確認したいです。
messages.writer_intent: Ask for sizing advice regarding shoe width and fit recommendation.

messages.message: I bought a daypack in black, order to-30007. The zipper is stiff. Do you sell replacement zipper sliders or is there a way to lubaricate it? I don't want to return it if it's a simple fix.
messages.writer_intent: Seek technical advice on fixing a stiff zipper and ask about replacement parts.

messages.message: Hallo, ich hatte im Mai eine e-Kettle bestellt (TO-60202). Die Glaskerze ist kaputt gegangen. Hättet ihr noch Ersatzfilter oder den Deckel KL-170-LID? Ich glaube nicht, dass ich noch im Garantiezeitraum bin, aber vielleicht habe ich Glück.
messages.writer_intent: Request spare parts for an out-of-warranty kettle and check eligibility for exchange.

messages.message: ¿Tienen repuestos para la lámpara DESK-LAMP blanca? El clip se aflojo y creo que se puede comprar solo el DL-CLAMP-M. También, ¿hacen envíos a México? El último pedido tardó mucho, quería saber si es normal.
messages.writer_intent: Inquire about desk lamp clamp availability and international shipping times to Mexico.

messages.message: 注文番号TO-60204でデスクランプを買いました。LEDモジュールを交換しようと思っていますが、DL-LED-5Wは5V用のやつですよね？使用説明書に電圧が書いてなかったのですが、確認できますか？
messages.writer_intent: Verify compatible voltage specifications for a specific LED spare part.

batches.brief: Customers who only want their money back (refund), with various reasons (defect, wrong size, late, changed mind), some angry, some polite.

messages.message: Hey, the jacket is way too small, just refund me plx. TO-20031
messages.writer_intent: Requests a refund due to wrong size.

messages.message: The kettle is leaking badly from the base. I never opened it. Just give me my money back please.
messages.writer_intent: Requests a refund for a defective product.

messages.message: Hi, I ordered the sneakers but I made a mistake with the size. Can I just cancel and get a full refund? Order TO-50120.
messages.writer_intent: Requests a refund due to a sizing error.

messages.message: Ich habe die Socken gestern geöffnet. Sie fühlen sich an wie Pappe. Das ist ein Witz. Ich erwartet einen Sofort-Rückerstattung. WO-40005
messages.writer_intent: Demands an immediate refund for unsatisfactory quality.

messages.message: El paquete llegó tres semanas tarde. No quiero el paquete, solo quiero mi dinero de vuelta. Es muy frustrante.
messages.writer_intent: Requests a refund due to late delivery.

messages.message: Hola, acabo de cambiar de opinión sobre la mochila. ¿Puedo hacer un reembolso completo y que recojan el artículo? Referencia TO-30077.
messages.writer_intent: Requests a refund after changing mind.

messages.message: こんにちは、注文品が届きましたが、カラーが希望と違ったので返金を希望します。受注番号TO-50101です。
messages.writer_intent: Requests a refund due to color mismatch.

messages.message: Hi, the lamp arrived with a cracked shade. I don't want a replacement, just please refund me. Sorry for the trouble.
messages.writer_intent: Requests a refund for a damaged item.

messages.message: 這件外套尺寸不合身，我完全無法穿。請直接進行退貨退款，謝謝。訂單編號 TO-20031。
messages.writer_intent: Requests a refund due to incorrect size.

messages.message: 瓦斯爐的閥門壞了，我已經檢查過不是我的使用問題。不想換零件，請直接退款。訂單是兩個月前下的。
messages.writer_intent: Requests a refund for a defective stove part.

batches.brief: Messages mixing two or more wishes or two problems at once, or where the customer is undecided ("exchange or refund, I don't know", "the lamp is broken and the kettle never came").

messages.message: Hi, my order TO-50110 is a mess. The kettle never showed up and the lamp arrived cracked. I don't know if I want a refund for the kettle or a replacement for the lamp, can you help me sort this out?
messages.writer_intent: Request clarification on handling a missing item and a damaged item from the same order.

messages.message: I ordered the trail runners in size 42, but they feel tight. I'm not sure if I should exchange them for size 43 or just return them, what is better for my case?
messages.writer_intent: Ask for advice on whether to exchange for a larger size or return the shoes.

messages.message: Hi, I bought the black desk lamp and it flickers. Also, the kettle I ordered at the same time has a leak. Do I have to send them back separately or can I bundle the complaints?
messages.writer_intent: Ask if multiple defective items from one order can be processed together.

messages.message: 我的訂單號應該是 TO-30077，但那個背包有點刮痕，而且我其實不確定要不要退錢還是換一個深藍色的？請告知。
messages.writer_intent: Report a scratched backpack and ask about the option to refund or exchange for a different color.

messages.message: 我剛看到我的帳單，買的那雙襪子（TO-40005）開線了，然後我之前還買了個燈（可能是 TO-50120？）也壞了。這兩個是一個處理還是分開？
messages.writer_intent: Report defects on socks and a lamp with an uncertain order number, asking about processing method.

messages.message: Hola, me llegó la chaqueta (TO-20031) pero se ve arrugada. No estoy segura si cambiarla por una L o pedir un reembolso, ¿me das alguna guía?
messages.writer_intent: Report a wrinkled jacket and ask for guidance on exchanging for a larger size or refunding.

messages.message: El termo eléctrico (creo que es TO-60201) no calienta y además los calcetines de lana que pedí a la vez tienen una costura rota. ¿Puedo devolver ambos a la vez?
messages.writer_intent: Report a non-heating kettle and damaged socks and ask to return both items together.

messages.message: Hallo, meine Bestellung TO-50140 ist schwierig zuhandhaben. Die Lampe ist schwarz, aber ich habe eigentlich weiß bestellt, UND der Wasserkocher hat einen Kratzer. Was soll ich machen, Tausch oder Rückerstattung?
messages.writer_intent: Report wrong color lamp and damaged kettle, asking whether to exchange or refund.

messages.message: Bestellung TO-60206, der Campingofen hat ein Leck und der Ersatzventil-Code CS-VALVE-2 passt nicht. Ich weiß nicht, ob ich nur das Ventil zurückgeben soll oder den ganzen Ofen?
messages.writer_intent: Report a leaking stove with a wrong valve part, asking whether to return just the part or the whole unit.

messages.message: 注文番号 TO-50101 です。デスクライト2台とも点滅します。返金か交換か迷っています。また、注文したマグカップ（ケトル？）が届いていない可能性もありますか？
messages.writer_intent: Report flickering lamps and ask about a missing kettle from the order, undecided between refund and exchange.

batches.brief: Messages with too little information to act on: no order number, no size, no part number, vague ("it doesn't work", "something is wrong"), or an order number that is slightly off.

messages.message: Hey, the shoe I got last week is too tight. Can I exchange it?
messages.writer_intent: The customer wants to exchange their Trail Runner sneakers but did not specify the size or order number.

messages.message: I bought order TO-104211 but I can't find it in my account. Is that right?
messages.writer_intent: The customer is trying to locate an order but provided a slightly incorrect order number with an extra digit.

messages.message: 我的燈沒亮, 請幫我換一個零件。
messages.writer_intent: The customer's desk lamp is not working and they want a replacement part, but did not specify which part or the order number.

messages.message: El calzado no me queda bien. Quiero devolverlo.
messages.writer_intent: The customer wants to return the shoes because they don't fit, but did not mention the size or order number.

messages.message: Me llegó algo roto del pedido TO-300777. ¿Qué pasa?
messages.writer_intent: The customer claims an item arrived broken for order TO-300777, which is a typo for their actual order TO-30077.

messages.message: Mein Wasserkocher macht seltsame Geräusche. Bitte um Hilfe.
messages.writer_intent: The customer's electric kettle is making strange noises and they need assistance, but provided no order number or specific model details.

messages.message: Bestellnummer TO-602015, die Jacke ist kaputt.
messages.writer_intent: The customer thinks their rain jacket is broken and cites order TO-602015, which is incorrect for their order TO-20031.

messages.message: 注文番号は忘れましたが、靴底が剥がれました。すぐ直したいです。
messages.writer_intent: The customer's shoe sole came off and they want a quick fix, but they forgot their order number and did not specify the size.

messages.message: 注文したランタンの部品が届きません。注文番号は TO-703031 です。
messages.writer_intent: The customer says a part for their camping stove (mistakenly called a lantern) didn't arrive and provided an extra digit in their order number.

messages.message: I need a refund for the socks I bought recently.
messages.writer_intent: The customer is requesting a refund for final-sale merino socks, which is likely policy-violating, and did not provide an order number or size.

batches.brief: Ordinary clear service requests: size/colour exchange, missing item to be sent again, broken product to be repaired or replaced, ordering a specific spare part for an item they own.

messages.message: Hi, I ordered the Trail Runner in size 42 but I think I made a mistake and actually need a 43. Is it possible to exchange them? Order was TO-10421.
messages.writer_intent: Exchange the sneakers from size 42 to size 43.

messages.message: 我買了黑色背包，但好像少了一個防雨罩。訂單號好像是 TO-30077，請幫我確認一下。
messages.writer_intent: Ask if a missing rain cover for the backpack can be sent.

messages.message: Hola, mi chubasquero se me rompió la cremallera en la primera semana. ¿Pueden repararlo o reemplazarlo? Es el pedido TO-20031.
messages.writer_intent: Request repair or replacement of a broken rain jacket zipper.

messages.message: Ich habe die Bestellnummer nicht mehr zur Hand, aber ich brauche dringend ein neues Gasventil für meinen Campingkocher (CS-VALVE-2). Kann ich das direkt bestellen?
messages.writer_intent: Order a spare gas valve for their camping stove without providing an order number.

messages.message: こんにちは、電気ケトルの蓋が壊れてしまったので、交換用の蓋(KL-170-LID)を注文したいのですが。注文番号はTO-50110だと思われます。
messages.writer_intent: Order a spare lid for their electric kettle.

messages.message: Hi there, I bought the white desk lamp but it arrived with the wrong color clamp. Can I swap it for the black one? I think the order was TO-50101.
messages.writer_intent: Exchange the desk lamp for a black one due to wrong color receipt.

messages.message: Hola, tengo una lámpara LED y necesito el módulo de 5W (DL-LED-5W) porque el original se quemó. ¿Me pueden enviar uno por separado? Mi correo es xia@example.test.
messages.writer_intent: Order a specific spare LED module for their desk lamp.

messages.message: Ich habe vor 4 Monaten einen Wasserkocher bestellt. Jetzt ist der Kalkfilter durch. Weißt du, ob ich den Filter (KL-170-FLT) separat kaufen kann?
messages.writer_intent: Buy a limescale filter spare part for an old kettle purchase.

messages.message: お世話になります。キャンプストーブのガスバルブを失くしてしまいました。注文番号TO-60206を購入した者ですが、部品だけ購入することは可能でしょうか。
messages.writer_intent: Inquire about purchasing a lost gas valve for their camping stove.

messages.message: Hey, I need to return the merino socks because they are too tight. Sorry for the late notice but I opened them last week. Order TO-40005. Can I get a different size?
messages.writer_intent: Request a size exchange for merino socks, acknowledging it might be a final sale issue.

batches.brief: Messages that mention a product problem word (broken, size, missing, part, …) but where the customer does NOT actually want anything done about an order — e.g. a negation ("not broken, just asking"), a hypothetical, praise, or a question before buying.

messages.message: Hi, sorry to bother you but the trail runner I bought 10 days ago isn't broken at all, I just wanted to confirm if they arrive with a waterproof coating or if I need to add some myself?
messages.writer_intent: Checking product specifications before using the item.

messages.message: 你好，我買的那台電水壺完全沒有壞掉，只是我想問一下如果以後水垢很多，那個濾網KL-170-FLT是怎麼清理的呀？
messages.writer_intent: Asking for maintenance instructions for a spare part.

messages.message: Hola, solo quería preguntar si la talla M de la chaqueta de ciudad es ajustada o holgada, porque la S me queda grande pero la M no la he probado aún.
messages.writer_intent: Inquiring about fit before deciding whether to return or keep the jacket.

messages.message: Hallo, mein Camp-Ofen funktioniert einwandfrei, aber ich habe mal gelesen, dass der Gasventil-Schlüssel oft verloren geht. Stimmt das, oder ist das Teil schon fest im Griff?
messages.writer_intent: Asking a hypothetical question about product durability.

messages.message: デスクランタンプの白いのは届いていませんが、もし届いたとして、LEDモジュールが黒いフレームと相性が悪いという噂が本当ですか？気にしすぎでしょうか。
messages.writer_intent: Questioning a rumor about product compatibility before receiving the item.

batches.note: top-up: requested 5 more because the first call returned fewer
